name: moondex
description: Moondex multi-agent planner-executor runtime, stack-aware team design, and operations workflows for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Bundle Moondex runtime, cmux operations, task creation, task planning, wave dispatch planning, stack-aware team design, diagnostics, and hook inspection workflows for Codex.
defaultPrompt: Use Moondex to operate a Moondex task through cmux role surfaces.
Use Moondex to decompose specs and designs into runtime-ready tasks.
Use Moondex to turn one validated task into an executor-ready plan.
Use Moondex to decide wave order and parallel dispatch from a complete plan set.
Use Moondex to design a project-local team from the target repository's technology stack.
Use Moondex to inspect Moondex runtime events and hook state.
Use Moondex to audit plugin quality, runtime readiness, and documentation drift.
